host:shellApproval.getUserlandSealedDeta.change: Adds a gated, read-only approval-plumbing method that accepts an approval id plus a host-computed digest and returns content only while that exact userland request is pending. direct:src/server/internalDOs/evalDO.ts:.change: Adds a host-only, gated code-execution authority that creates or refreshes the exact EvalDO incarnation's bounded idle residency lease. The receiver validates the lease identity and duration, and no user or code principal may invoke it directly.
Adds a host-only, gated code-execution authority that atomically claims the single held-request slot for an already-active exact kernel lease. It cannot create, widen, or extend a lease.

Adds a host-only, gated code-execution authority whose request remains held only for the exact attached lease and settles on expiry, release, or replacement. It exposes no scope data and cannot outlive the receiver-owned lease deadline.

host:eval.dispose.change: Adds explicit release for an EvalDO whose immutable first activation declared it finite. The receiver derives the exact object from the verified owner and subkey, rejects persistent scopes, erases the finite object's durable records and loaded runtime, and retires it through the normal sealed lifecycle and cleanup reaper. Closing this owned finite resource is open and cannot address another caller's eval state.

host:durableWork.inspect.change: Adds an open, read-only bounded inspection of host durable-work counters and phase timings. It exposes no work payloads, transcript content, credentials, or mutation authority.

host:gitInterop.publishRepo.change: Retiers the transport to open only after moving code-originated publish authority into a schema-owned prepared leaf. User and host callers retain the declared service authority; code callers cannot enter the handler until the exact destination selection is approved.

host:gitInterop.publishRepo#capability:g.change: Adds a gated code-only prepared authority leaf for one normalized provider, credential selection, and repository name. The registered preparer derives the exact external-repository resource and user-facing change substance before handler entry.

host:vcs.listDirectory.change: Adds an open, read-only immediate-child directory projection over the caller's existing semantic VCS read authority. Work is bounded by returned visible entries and does not enumerate descendant file content.

host:vcs.readMemory.change: Adds an open, read-only projection over the caller's existing context-scoped semantic VCS authority. It accepts a canonical managed path, exact returned-bytes hash, and bounded UTF-16 range; returns only bounded blame-backed episodes and typed roots; and owns no facts, claims, mutation, or traversal state.

host:permissions.safetyStatus.change: Adds the permission inventory's bounded read of workspace and per-agent authority locks; the ordinary permissions.read capability and workspace membership checks remain in force.

host:permissions.setWorkspaceAuthorityLo.change: Adds the critical control that durably blocks protected agent authority workspace-wide before interrupting live agent transports. Releasing the barrier uses the same reviewed critical capability.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Adds a host-only lifecycle operation that enumerates the exact agent vessel's subscribed channels and interrupts their active transports while flushing deferred work; no user, code, or entity principal can invoke it directly.

direct:workspace/packages/semantic-contr.change: Adds an open, read-only exact-coordinate projection over existing trajectory, semantic command, effect-intent, and receipt authorities; every collection is bounded and reports truncation, and the method performs no mutation.

host:contextIntegrity.explain.change: Adds a read-only agent-bound explanation of a lineage coordinate already present in the caller's own session. The receiver derives session identity, verifies aggregate content addressing, and returns bounded opaque-cursor pages.

host:systemAgent.resolveConversation.change: Restores the reviewed open-tier census entry for resolving the caller's own product-owned System Agent conversation; workspace membership and the pinned trusted-code roster remain independent receiver checks.

host:app.openShellSurface.change: Adds open navigation to an enumerated first-party shell management surface in the current client; it neither opens an external system nor changes managed state, and the receiver rejects unknown targets.

host:onboardingStatus.read.change: Adds a read-only aggregate of existing host-owned onboarding facts for the calling workspace and device; it returns normalized status only, performs no live verification, and exposes no credential secret.

direct:src/server/internalDOs/workspaceD.change: Adds one host-only, read-only projection of the open slots, histories, and current entity records already exposed through granular WorkspaceDO reads. It performs no mutation and replaces startup fanout with one internally consistent transaction.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Adds a host-only, open runtime-intrinsic wake hint after an authority acquisition settles. Durable effect outbox state remains the continuation and ordinary alarms recover a lost hint.
Adds a host-only lifecycle operation that attaches an existing exact agent entity to a channel; the channel independently authenticates the subscribing Durable Object identity.

direct:workspace/workers/pubsub-channel/.change: Adds host-only atomic initialization of an immutable exact-participant channel boundary; user and code callers cannot create, replace, or widen the locked membership policy.

direct:workspace/packages/runtime/src/wo.change: Exposes only the receiver's fixed supported durable-work queue names to the host activation hook; it reads no semantic or user data.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Installs the exact host durable-work worker generation on one concrete agent vessel and releases only claims owned by the positively superseded generation. No user or code principal is admitted, and elapsed time cannot transfer ownership.

direct:workspace/workers/pubsub-channel/.change: Installs the exact host durable-work worker generation on one concrete channel and releases only claims owned by the positively superseded generation. No user or code principal is admitted, and elapsed time cannot transfer ownership.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Adds bounded all-or-nothing local admission of an exact channel batch addressed to the active vessel incarnation; it performs no remote execution.
Adds bounded generation-fenced claims over the exact vessel's local inbox and effect projections; no code or user principal is admitted.
Adds a bounded host read of queue readiness and next recovery time without exposing descriptors or transcript content.
Executes only an already generation-fenced effect claim on the exact vessel; live authority is re-evaluated by the narrow executor ports.
Executes only an already generation-fenced local inbox transition on the exact vessel, with GAD retaining semantic ordering authority.

Settles only the exact worker and generation; stale hosts cannot mutate a newer inbox or effect claim.

direct:workspace/workers/pubsub-channel/.change: Adds bounded generation-fenced claims over exact recipient-incarnation batches and channel recovery items.
Adds a bounded host read of channel work readiness and recovery time without exposing message payloads.

Records bounded retry state only for the exact channel worker and worker generation.
Requires exact worker/generation settlement and a complete gap-free per-row acknowledgement for recipient batches.
